DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜の大きな音について相談したいです。自分で聞いた日と、友人から聞いた日があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜間音の相談で本人経験日と友人の話の日を区別して申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to discuss loud noises at night. There is a day when I heard them myself, and another day I heard about from a friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: When asking about nighttime noise, distinguish the day you experienced it yourself from the day your friend told you about. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、ご自身で聞いた日時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please tell me the date and time when you heard it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は昨夜十一時に自宅で聞きました。一昨日のことは友人の話です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人は昨夜十一時に聞き一昨日は友人の話だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I heard it at home at eleven last night. What happened the night before is something my friend told me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you heard it yourself at eleven last night, while the report about the night before came from your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを分けて伺います。昨夜はどのような音でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will take those separately. What kind of noise was it last night?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何かが何度もぶつかる音でした。何をしていたかは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 繰返し衝突音を聞いたが原因行動は見ていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It sounded like something repeatedly banging against something else. I did not see what anyone was doing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you heard repeated impacts but did not see the activity causing them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因を見ていない点も記録します。音が続いた時間はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also record that you did not see the cause. Do you know how long the noise continued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正確には測っていません。五分くらいと感じましたが、推測です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未計測で五分程度は体感による推測と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not time it precisely. It felt like about five minutes, but that is an estimate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you did not measure it and that about five minutes is an estimate based on your impression. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように、体感の時間として伺います。友人の話も本人経験とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take it as your impression of the duration. Your friend's account is also separate from your own experience.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜自分で聞いた内容だけ先に説明し、別日の話は伝聞だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人経験を先に伝え別日の話は伝聞として説明すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will first explain only what I heard myself last night and identify the story about another day as secondhand information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will describe your own experience first and explain that the account from another day is secondhand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。本人の経験と伝聞を分けて担当へ伝えます。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will distinguish your own experience from secondhand information when passing it to the person in charge. Thank you for asking us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この箱の宛先に部屋番号を書き忘れました。小さい余白へ足しても大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宛先の部屋番号漏れを狭い余白へ追記できるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot to write the room number in the address on this box. Is it all right to add it in this small blank space?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can add the missing room number to a narrow blank space in the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読める表示に整えましょう。新しい宛名ラベルを使う方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us make the address clearly readable. One option is to use a new address label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 端に無理に書くより、住所を全部書き直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 小文字追記でなく住所全体を新ラベルへ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Rather than squeeze it in at the edge, I would like to write out the entire address again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to rewrite the whole address on a new label instead of adding small writing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ではこちらのラベルをご利用ください。正しい部屋番号は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please use this label. Have you confirmed the correct room number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手に聞いて、三〇二号室と確認しました。番地の後へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手確認済み三〇二号室を番地後へ記すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I asked the recipient and confirmed that it is room 302. I will put it after the street address number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have confirmed room302 with the recipient and will write it after the street address number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新ラベルを貼るときは、旧住所表示が残って紛らわしくならないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When attaching the new label, please make sure the old address is not left visible and confusing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古いラベルを外せるので、外してから新しい物を貼ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外せる旧ラベルを除去して新ラベルを貼ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can remove the old label, so I will take it off before attaching the new one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will remove the removable old label and attach the new one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。郵便番号、住所、宛名を一緒に読み直しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us reread the postal code, address, and addressee together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三〇二号室を含む新ラベルへ替え、古い表示を残さず発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号入り新表示へ替え旧表示を残さず発送すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will replace it with the new label including room302 and send it without leaving the old address visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will replace the label with a new one including the room number and ship it without leaving the old information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。整いましたらお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will take it once it is ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知を電子で受けたいです。ただ、会社へ出す取引の記録は紙で必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行通知を電子希望だが職場提出取引記録は紙で必要と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to receive notices electronically. However, I need a paper transaction record to submit to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about receiving bank notices electronically while still needing a paper transaction record for your workplace. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知の受取設定と、提出する記録の用意は分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check notification delivery settings separately from preparing the record you need to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電子化したら紙の記録が一切取れなくなると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電子化で紙記録が一切得られないと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought switching to electronic notices would mean I could no longer get any paper records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought going electronic meant no paper records would be available at all. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記録の種類によって方法が違います。会社はどの書類を求めていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The method differs by record type. Which document does your company require?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 取引日と金額がわかる物です。正式な書類名はまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取引日と額が必要だが正式書類名は未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Something showing the transaction date and amount. I have not asked for the formal document name yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the transaction date and amount are needed but that the formal document name is unconfirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出先の条件を確かめてから、発行や印刷の方法を相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please confirm the recipient's requirements before asking about issuance or printing methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に電子化を決めず、必要な記録名と受取設定の選択肢を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設定前に記録名と通知受取選択肢を別々に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Before deciding to go electronic, I will check the name of the record I need and the notification delivery options.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that before changing settings, you want to check the record name and notification delivery options separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。通知を止める操作と、記録を残す希望を別々に担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I will convey the operation to stop notices separately from your wish to retain records to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社へ書類条件を聞き、通知の設定だけで提出準備が済むとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社書類条件を確認し通知設定だけで準備完了とみなさないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask my company about the document requirements and will not consider preparation complete just because I have set up notices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm your company's document requirements and not regard notification settings alone as completing preparation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will show you to the counter in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この洗剤は買わないことにしました。まだ支払う前ですが、取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未支払の会計で洗剤一品の購入取消しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have decided not to buy this detergent. I have not paid yet. Can you cancel it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to cancel the purchase of one detergent item during checkout before payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品をこちらへお渡しください。登録した状態を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please hand the item to me. I will check whether it has been entered.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋にはまだ入れていません。牛乳は買うので、洗剤だけ外したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 袋詰め前で牛乳は買い洗剤だけ除外希望と明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not put it in a bag yet. I am buying the milk, so I want to remove only the detergent.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that nothing has been bagged yet, you will buy the milk, and you only want the detergent removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの会計では洗剤を登録済みです。登録を取り消して合計を直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The detergent has already been entered in this transaction. I will remove the entry and correct the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。洗剤を棚へ自分で戻す前に、お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己返却前に洗剤を店員へ渡すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will hand you the detergent before taking it back to the shelf myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will give the detergent to the staff member before returning it to the shelf yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでお預かりしました。新しい合計を表示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have taken it here. I will display the new total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 牛乳とほかの購入品だけの合計になったか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入継続品だけの修正後合計を確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to check that the total is only for the milk and the other items I am still buying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to confirm the corrected total includes only the items you still intend to buy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示をご覧ください。取消した品は購入の内訳から外れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the display. The canceled item has been removed from the purchase breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 洗剤の取消しを確認できました。この合計で支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 洗剤取消結果を確認し修正合計で支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed the detergent was canceled. I will pay this total.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the detergent cancellation and will pay the corrected total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お忘れ物のないようお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please make sure you have all your belongings when you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 暗くなってきました。照明があれば、このまま夜まで歩いてもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園の照明があれば夜まで散歩できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is getting dark. If there are lights, may I keep walking here into the evening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can continue walking in the park until nighttime if there is lighting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 照明の有無だけで利用できる時間は決まりません。こちらの掲示の退出案内を見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether there are lights does not by itself determine when the area may be used. Let us look at the exit instructions on this notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夕方の案内が出ていますね。電灯を待てばよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方退出表示を読み点灯待ちでよいと思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: There are instructions for the evening. I thought I just needed to wait for the lights to come on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the evening exit notice and explain that you thought waiting for the lights would be enough. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は奥へ進まず、現在地から出口へ戻る経路を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today, please check a route back to the exit from where you are rather than going farther in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 暗い土の道ではなく、足元が見える通路で戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 暗い土道より足元が見える帰路を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to return along a path where I can see my footing instead of a dark dirt path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer a return route with visible footing rather than a dark dirt path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの表示に沿った通路です。見えにくい場合は無理に先へ進まず声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is the path following these signs. If it is difficult to see, do not push on; please ask for help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連れと一緒なので、離れず同じ通路を歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者と離れず同通路で戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am with a companion, so we will stay together on the same path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay with your companion and take the same path back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。近道の柵を越えず、出口表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Let us check the exit signs rather than climb over a fence for a shortcut.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 照明を待って滞在せず、二人で足元を確認しながら出口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 点灯待ち滞在をせず二人で足元を見て退出すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will not stay waiting for the lights. The two of us will watch our footing as we return to the exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will leave together while watching your footing, instead of staying to wait for the lights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人で予約しましたが、連れだけ行けなくなりました。私の分は残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人予約の同行者だけ不参加となり本人分を残したいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I made a booking for two, but only my companion can no longer go. I want to keep my own place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to keep your own place in a two-person booking when only your companion will not participate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約はまとめて一件になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you both included in one booking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、二人の名前が一つの予約にあります。まだ取消しはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一件に二名あり取消未操作と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, there are two names in one booking. I have not canceled anything yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one booking contains two names and that you have not performed a cancellation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 人数の一部変更について窓口で確認しましょう。全部の取消しボタンは押さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check at the counter about changing only some of the passengers. Please do not press the button to cancel everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の名前と、行けない連れの名前を別々に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人名と不参加者名を区別して担当へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will give my own name and my companion's name separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish your own name from the nonparticipating person's name when telling the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当へお伝えください。変更の条件も予約内容で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell the person in charge what you would like. They will also check the conditions for changes against the booking details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私は予定どおり今日乗ります。日時を二人とも変更する話ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人は本日予定どおり乗り日時全体変更ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am traveling today as planned. This is not a request to change both people's dates and times.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that you will travel today as planned and are not requesting a change to the date and time of the entire booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。本日のご本人分を残し、同行者分だけを相談するということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You want to keep your own booking for today and discuss only your companion's portion.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのとおりです。一人分だけ変更できるかと、結果の確認方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一人分変更可否と結果確認方法を窓口へ尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Exactly. I will ask whether only one person's portion can be changed and how to check the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask at the counter whether a change for one person is possible and how to confirm the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come to this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 市へ道路について意見を出したいです。名前や電話番号も公開されるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市への道路意見提出で氏名電話番号が公開対象か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to submit an opinion about a road to the city. Will my name and phone number also be made public?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your name and phone number would be public when submitting a road-related opinion to the city. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この用紙の取扱い説明を確認しましょう。回答を受け取る希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check this form's explanation of how information is handled. Would you also like to receive a response?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、回答は欲しいですが、電話番号を意見と一緒に公開したくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 回答希望だが連絡番号の意見同時公開は希望しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I would like a response, but I do not want my phone number published with my opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want a reply but do not want your contact number published together with your opinion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 回答用の連絡先と公表の項目を担当へ確認します。ここで一律に公開すると決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will ask the person in charge about contact details for replies and which fields are published. We will not assume here that everything is made public.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認が済むまで番号欄は書かず、意見の内容を先に下書きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取扱確認まで番号未記入で意見だけ下書きすると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave the number field blank until that is confirmed and first draft the opinion itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the number blank until its handling is confirmed and draft only the opinion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どの道路の、どの場所についての意見でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which road and which location is your opinion about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通勤路の横断する場所です。場所の説明と、見えにくいと感じた点を書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通勤の横断地点と見通しについての本人感想を具体的に説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: A crossing on my route to work. I would like to describe the location and what I feel is difficult to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the crossing on your commuting route and your own impressions about visibility specifically. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 個人の感想と具体的な場所を分けて書けます。公開項目も担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can write your personal impression separately from the specific location. The person in charge will also explain which details are published.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所と意見を下書きし、連絡先の扱いを聞いてから正式に提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 意見下書き後に連絡先取扱確認をして正式提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will draft the location and my opinion, ask how contact details are handled, and then make the formal submission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that after drafting your opinion, you will confirm how contact details are handled and then formally submit it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will take you to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 説明を後で思い出したいです。連れが録音を勧めましたが、始める前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明記録の録音を開始前に相談したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to remember the explanation later. My companion suggested recording it, but I would like to ask before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to ask about recording the explanation before starting a recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ録音は始めていませんね。診療担当へ可否と方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You have not started recording yet, correct? I will ask the clinical staff whether and how it is permitted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。電話は鞄にあります。許可がないまま録音はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未録音で許可前に電話を使わないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I have not. My phone is in my bag. I will not record without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that you are not recording and will not use the phone before permission is given. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモを取りたい希望も担当へ伝えられます。どのように残したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can also tell the staff member that you would like to take notes. How would you like to keep a record?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大事な点を一つずつ聞き返して、自分の紙に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重要点を一つずつ復唱確認し本人紙へメモしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to ask about each important point again, one by one, and write it on my own paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to repeat and confirm important points one at a time and note them on your own paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を伝えます。メモした内容が合うか、説明した担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will pass that request along. Please check with the person giving the explanation that your notes are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連れの解釈だけで決めず、自分で確認して記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者の解釈だけで決めず本人が担当へ確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check and record it myself rather than decide based only on my companion's interpretation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm with the staff member yourself rather than rely only on your companion's interpretation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要な説明資料があるかも担当へ聞きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Let us also ask the person in charge whether there are any explanatory materials you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 録音は先に相談し、メモは本人用として確認しながら残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 録音可否を事前相談し本人用メモを内容確認しながら残すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask about recording beforehand, and keep notes for myself while checking that the contents are correct.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask about permission to record in advance and take notes for personal use while checking their accuracy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。診療担当へそのご希望を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I will convey those wishes to the clinical staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 銀行の人だと言う方が家へ来ました。名刺はありますが、本当の職員か確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行職員を名乗る訪問者の名刺はあるが身元未確認と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone who said they were from the bank came to my home. I have a business card, but I have not confirmed that they are really an employee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a visitor claiming to be a bank employee whose identity is unconfirmed despite having a business card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在その方は近くにいますか。ご自身は安全な場所にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that person nearby now? Are you in a safe place yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もう帰りました。私は家族と家にいます。口座の書類を見せてほしいと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問者退出済みで家族と安全な家におり口座資料提示を求められたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They have already left. I am at home with my family. They asked me to show them account documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the visitor has left, that you are safely at home with family, and that they asked to see account documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類やお金、カードなどを渡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Did you hand over any documents, money, cards, or similar items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 渡していません。名刺を受け取りましたが、その番号には電話していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 金品資料未交付で名刺番号へ未架電と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I did not. I accepted the business card, but I have not called the number on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have not handed over money, valuables, or documents, and have not called the business card number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 名刺があることと身元が確認できたことは別です。訪問の日時と話した内容を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Having a business card and confirming someone's identity are separate things. Let me ask the date and time of the visit and what they said.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の午前です。相手の名前は名刺の表記として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問は本日午前で名前は名刺表記に過ぎないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was this morning. I will provide their name only as the name printed on the business card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Make clear that the visit was this morning and that the name is only what appears on the business card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。銀行への確認が必要なら、別に確かめた正式な窓口を使う相談ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If you need to check with the bank, we can discuss using an official contact point verified separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名刺だけで信じず、要求された内容と何も渡していないことを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名刺だけで身元認定せず要求内容と未交付の事実を報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not trust them based on the card alone. I will explain what they requested and that I did not hand anything over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not establish their identity from the business card alone and will report the request and the fact that nothing was handed over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未確認の身元として相談担当へつなぎます。お知らせくださりありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will connect you with the adviser with the identity marked as unconfirmed. Thank you for letting us know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 送り状のコードを電話に出しましたが、うまく読めません。表示を直してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電話の電子送り状コードが読み取れず表示修正を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought up the shipping label code on my phone, but it will not scan properly. May I adjust the display?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about adjusting the display because the electronic shipping label code on your phone cannot be read. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの受付では、そのコード画面を確認します。画面が暗くなっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: At this counter, we check that code screen. Your screen has gone dim.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自動で暗くなりました。明るくして、コードの部分を開き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暗くなった画面を明るくして当該コードを再表示すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It dimmed automatically. I will brighten it and reopen the code section.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will brighten the dimmed screen and display the relevant code again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: コード全体が見える表示でお願いします。周りの余白も切らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please display the whole code. Do not crop out the blank margin around it either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きくしすぎて端が切れていました。全体を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 拡大で切れた端を戻してコード全体を見せると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I enlarged it too much and cut off the edges. I will show the whole thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will undo the enlargement that cropped the edges and show the entire code. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ほかの住所一覧を開く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. There is no need to open any other address list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この荷物のコードだけを見せ、別の宛先画面は閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象荷物コードだけを提示し他宛先の画面は閉じると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will show only this parcel's code and close the screen for other addressees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will show only the code for the parcel concerned and close screens for other addresses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 読取が済むまで、この画面をそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep holding this screen as it is until scanning is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 明るい画面でコード全体を出し、受付結果を聞くまで閉じません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 明るい全体コード画面を受付確認まで保持すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the entire code on a bright screen and not close it until I hear the acceptance result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will keep the bright screen showing the full code until acceptance is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: コードを確認できました。次の受付はこちらです。ご準備ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the code. The next reception step is over here. Thank you for preparing it.
